chunks: Let loose at you will be smokeless flames of fire and smoke, so that you will not be able to defend yourselves.

key_terms.فَلاَ تَنْتَصِرَانِ: So you will not be able to defend yourselves

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Shawaz' and 'Nuhass' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Rahman is often interpreted as addressing both Iblis and humanity, describing the 'shuwaz' (flames of fire) and 'nuhas' (brass/smoke) as distinct elements of divine retribution. The command 'so you will not prevail' underscores the futility of their combined resistance against Allah's will, a theme central to the concept of divine justice in the Hereafter.
